result.document_summary: A page from the San Diego Municipal Code (Chapter 3, Article 3, Police Regulated Occupations and Businesses) covering appeal procedures, exempt institutions, and promoter permits, retrieved under a URL that refers to an algorithmic rent-price-fixing division but containing none of that text.
result.notes: This part (sections 33.0405 through 33.0703) concerns police-permit regulatory actions, appeal hearings, permit-fee exemptions, and promoter permits. None of it addresses rent increase limits, just-cause eviction, security deposits, screening fees, screening restrictions, or algorithmic rent setting. The URL points to a division on prohibiting algorithmic rent price fixing (§ 98.1103), but that text does not appear in this part, so no rule is extracted.
